lines.english: A white flower, I give you a white flower
lines.note: darujem ti: Verb 'darovať' takes the dative pronoun 'ti' (to you) and accusative object 'biely kvet'.

lines.english: a white flower that smells sweet inside us

lines.text: môžeš ho [vziať], môžeš sa s ním smiať
lines.english: you can take it, you can laugh with it
lines.note: môcť + infinitív: 'môžeš ho vziať' pairs modal verb 'môžeš' with accusative masculine pronoun 'ho'.

lines.english: it will grow as long as our time lasts
lines.note: futúrum: 'bude rásť' forms the imperfective future using 'bude' + infinitive.
